title: RSR-002: research record/source/claim checks in the gate
objective: Begin enforcing the frozen research contract: badf_gate.py research validates a record's schema, referential integrity, derived confidence, and the VERIFIED/OBSERVED primary-source invariants (RSR-I02/I03). Research grants no implementation authority (schema-fixed).
business_value: A frozen contract nobody validates is documentation. These are the deterministic record/source/claim controls -- the ones that are pure functions of the record.
in_scope: schema/example/doc aligned so confidence is computable (example C-002 HIGH->MODERATE)
out_of_scope: baseline git-resolution (control 3) -- when a repository-research subskill lands
the nine P0 subskills; registry activation (badf-research stays DESIGNED)
acceptance_criteria: an asserted confidence != the derived level is refused
a dangling source or finding ref is refused
a VERIFIED claim without an independent primary source is refused; an OBSERVED claim without a primary source is refused
derive_confidence truth table holds and every result is a schema enum
mutation kills; compose green both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Carries its own G07 self-dossier. First of the research-track WPs after the contract freeze.
